extracted.name: Slow Cooker Pineapple Chicken
extracted.description: This slow cooker pineapple chicken thighs recipe delivers sweet and sour chicken thighs and pineapple using ketchup, brown sugar, and garlic.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup all-purpose flour, or as needed
instruction_lines: Put flour into a shallow bowl. Dredge chicken thighs in flour to coat; tapping thighs to remove excess flour.
Arrange chicken thighs in the bottom of your slow cooker crock; top with pineapple chunks.
Whisk pineapple juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, ketchup, and garlic together in a small bowl; pour over chicken and pineapple in the slow cooker.
